title: CWI - Creating War Industry
description: An industrial war-themed modpack built around Create and Vic’s Point Blank, designed for use on my friend’s SMP.
body:
# 📦 Creating War Industry

**Creating War Industry’s** is an **automation-, combat-, and exploration-focused modpack** for Minecraft 1.20.1 (future updates planned for 1.20.x – 1.21.x).  
Built for **SMP**, **industrial-style survival** and **Fun** it combines the engineering power of *Create* with the modern weaponry of *Vic’s Point Blank* and deep progression systems.

Made to bring together **technology, adventure, and chaos** — in one balanced experience. ⚙️🔫🌍

⚠️ **Work in progress** – modpack is not final!
Mods, configs, and balance may change over time.

## ✅ Key Features

- 🏭 **Create-based automation** with multiple addons  
- 🔫 **Vic’s Point Blank firearms** and PvP enhancements  
- ⚗️ **RPG & progression** with Tinkers’ Construct, Lifesteal, Apotheosis  
- 🌍 **Exploration & world variety** – Biomes O’ Plenty, Terralith, The Aether  
- 🧰 **Utility mods** – backpacks, compass, first aid, revive system  
- 🎙️ **Voice Chat** support for SMPs  
- ⚖️ Balanced configs for smooth tech + combat gameplay


## ❗️ Notes
- Perfect for **SMP survival with friends**  
- Great mix of **automation, tech, and PvP**  
- Ideal for **Create engineers** who want action too  
- **Balanced progression** for long-term worlds
- Still in **early development** — modlist, configs, and balance are changing  
- Built mainly around **Create + Vic’s Point Blank** core gameplay  
- Not focused on performance or minimalism → it’s about **content & progression**  
- Requires **Forge 1.20.1** (Fabric version not planned yet)
